ns2:section.sectionText: Course is designed to provide students with a well-rounded immersion in the complex issues and constraints involved in the linkages of food/wine production, business management, policy making and the environment. This class explores these linkages and relationships through the lens of California agribusinesses. Important comparisons are made to issues and challenges facing Midwest agribusinesses. The class includes a 7-day study tour to California over Spring Break. Email jbecker2@illinois.edu regarding registration and course information. IMPORTANT! STUDENTS WHO DROP THE COURSE AFTER WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 28 ARE RESPONSIBLE FOR A NON-REFUNDABLE DEPOSIT OF $400 TO COVER AIRFARE THAT HAS BEEN BOOKED IN ADVANCE AT A DISCOUNTED RATE.
